# Results

**n** = 1000 (300 bad) · **labels**: UCI Statlog German Credit labels (1994), recoded 2 = bad · **scorer**: deterministic code (scikit-learn metrics on pooled out-of-fold predictions) · **model**: champion-lr-sigmoid-v1 · **run date**: 2026-10-29 · **uncertainty**: percentile bootstrap, 2000 row resamples, 95% · **validation**: repeated stratified 5-fold CV x 5, seed 20261029

## Model

| Metric (95% CI) | Champion | Challenger | Spread across repeats (champion) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AUROC | 0.780 [0.751, 0.810] | 0.792 [0.763, 0.820] | 0.771 to 0.781 |
| Expected cost per applicant | 0.541 [0.488, 0.598] | 0.537 [0.479, 0.593] | 0.538 to 0.561 |
| Brier score | 0.166 [0.155, 0.179] | 0.163 [0.152, 0.175] | 0.165 to 0.169 |
| ECE (10 bins) | 0.016 [0.018, 0.051] | 0.032 [0.025, 0.063] | 0.016 to 0.028 |

Trivial baselines: approve everyone **1.50**, decline everyone **0.70** per applicant.

Challenger minus champion (paired bootstrap): AUROC 0.012 [-0.003, 0.029]; expected cost -0.004 [-0.053, 0.043].

Policy: threshold 0.1667, refer ceiling 0.25; out-of-fold band counts approve 339, refer 161, decline 500.

Serving model: fitted on n = 1000; attribution reference `approve_band_training_mean` (n = 340); calibration slope -0.806 (negative = monotone increasing).

## Analyst live-model run (not gated)

**n** = 15 questions · **labels**: designed by construction (single author); expectations are tool calls and refusals, not answer quality · **scorer**: deterministic code checks on tool calls and refusals, plus the analyst's own grounding check; no human or LLM judge of answer quality · **model**: gpt-4o-mini · **run date**: 2026-10-30 · **uncertainty**: n = 15 is too small for a confidence interval; read these as a smoke test of one model, not a rate

Behaved as expected (right tools, refusals, approval held): **15 / 15**. Of 12 answers containing numbers: 10 verified first try, 1 after one repair, 1 flagged unverified. Median 4.8 s per question.
